unit_attributes.statement: For application review, a review notice (RN) means a written request for missing application records.
In application review, applicants must return the review notice (RN) within ten days unless a reviewer extends the deadline.
In application review, reviewers may extend that deadline by five days only with a supervisor's approval.
unit_attributes.scope_text: For application review, regarding extending the deadline to return the review notice (RN)

unit_attributes.statement: Within equipment inspections, a review notice (RN) means a record that an inspection was completed; it is not a request for records.
Within equipment inspections, inspectors must issue an RN after completing an inspection.
Within equipment inspections, operators may archive that RN only after a manager's approval.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Within equipment inspections, regarding the issued RN

unit_attributes.statement: Within equipment inspections, you must retain a copy of the approval email.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Within equipment inspections, regarding the manager's approval to archive the RN

unit_attributes.statement: Under general record handling, records must be retained for two years.
ZX is an external reference code whose meaning is not supplied here.
